reason: The marker importer replaced existing DoAction scripts with marker-only scripts because the patch directory did not contain the source action bodies. This removed existing source logic (including frame 42 jump=1 and frame 588 special setup/energy/position writes); the different frame 503 route is caused by destructive instrumentation, not evidence of a static-fixture routing defect. All markers from this run are invalid as behavior evidence.

observations.scope: Markers prove source frame tag dispatch only, not hardware playback.
observations.source_sound_tag_markers_note: These marker calls replaced source actions in this invalid run; do not interpret as valid tag dispatch.

probe_defect.confirmed_by: Diff of existing dynamic exact SWF source scripts against the marker-instrumented test SWF: frame_588 DoAction lost 动作=3, bs=1, ql-=100, jump=1, and parent x/y assignments; frame_42 lost jump=1; frame_116 lost khit/jump writes.
probe_defect.corrected_probe: The probe now exports current source scripts, chooses an action relative to the StartSound tag in SWF tag order, adds markers without replacing source actions, verifies exported source-plus-marker text, and marks frames with no DoAction as unsupported.
